end.summary:
Ishita named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere; this was shown on a new-situation question.
Ishita recognised 3D shapes in different positions and sizes; this was shown on a new-situation question.
Ishita matched some everyday objects to 3D shapes; this was practised and needs more checking next time.
The distinction between a sphere and a cylinder was discussed using curved and flat surfaces; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming the five 3D shapes and recognising them when their position or size changed. Ishita used dice, bricks, balls and a glass to discuss cube, cuboid, sphere and cylinder. Everyday-object matching was partly right, while the difference between a sphere and a cylinder still needs another check; it was not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask Ishita to find one object for each shape and say which surfaces or ends helped them decide.
